# OmniStack Digital

> Websites, web applications and AI automation, built and owned outright. No monthly platform fees: every project ships with the code, the domain and the hosting account in the client's name.

## What this is

OmniStack Digital is a solo-built, self-hosted web studio. Every site is built on Next.js, rendered ahead of time, and handed over with full ownership: the repository, the domain and the hosting account transfer to the client, and running a typical site costs a few dollars a month on the client's own hosting rather than a recurring platform fee.

## Services

- [Website Development](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/website-development): fast, self-hosted marketing sites with a content editor, no platform fee
- [Web Applications](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/web-applications): production web apps with real auth, roles and a database the client owns
- [Mobile Applications](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/mobile-applications): React Native apps, built only when a native app is genuinely the right call
- [Custom Software](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/custom-software): internal tools and integrations for problems off the shelf software does not solve
- [SaaS Platforms](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/saas-platforms): multi-tenant products with billing, onboarding and admin
- [API Integrations](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/api-integrations): reliable connections between the systems a business already runs
- [AI Automation](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/ai-automation): agents and automations audited for genuine value before anything is built
- [UI/UX Design](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/ui-ux-design): interface design built in the same system it ships in
- [Performance Optimization](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/performance-optimization): Core Web Vitals fixes measured before and after
- [SEO](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/seo): technical SEO built into the site rather than sold as a retainer
- [Digital Marketing](https://omnistacksdigital.com/services/digital-marketing): campaigns measured against revenue, scoped honestly against when they are not worth running

## Industries

Restaurants and hospitality, health and fitness, SaaS and startups, e-commerce and retail, professional services, and real estate. Full list at https://omnistacksdigital.com/industries.

## Work

Real, delivered projects only: https://omnistacksdigital.com/work. Template concepts, not client work, are kept separate at https://omnistacksdigital.com/templates and are labelled as such on every card.

## Reviews

Client reviews at https://omnistacksdigital.com/reviews are published unedited, with an explicit label on each card for whether it has been verified. No star ratings or aggregate score are shown or claimed.
